name: Cetrelimab
sort_evidence: Cetrelimab is an unapproved anti-PD-1 J&J uses only as a combination partner; SunRISe-2 (TAR-200 plus cetrelimab, NCT04658862) was discontinued for futility in September 2024 (https://www.jnj.com/media-center/press-releases/johnson-johnson-statement-on-the-sunrise-2-study), and no J&J filing names cetrelimab as a programme of its own.
